database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fieldsToCopy.description: The key-value pairs map the old template fields to the new template fields. The key represents the old template field, and the value represents the new template field.

id.description: The ID of the item to set the template for. Supply this or path.

path.description: The path of the item to set the template for. Supply this or id.

template.description: The path representing the template item.
